method: Observed campaign runs using shipped previews, tooltips, traits, contextual coaching, and the existing deterministic balance capture for numerical triage.

sessions.note: Read Fast but missed that Fortified Bulwarks held the front; understood after hovering the preview trait and reading the map briefing.

sessions.build: lancer x3; cannon x1; slow x1
sessions.note: Correctly avoided relying on slow against Relentless; peak crossing density exceeded the funded coverage.

sessions.build: lancer x7; cannon x1; poison x1; slow x1
sessions.note: One front Bulwark delayed target acquisition while the paired platoon crossed.
Assumed every Fast counter remained effective; preview/trait counter text explained Relentless shake-off before retry.

sessions.build: lancer x3; cannon x1; slow x1
sessions.note: Correct counters and low reserve still leaked the staggered second front.

sessions.build: lancer x8; cannon x1; poison x1; slow x1
sessions.note: Paired threat pressure left no placement recovery window.
Did not connect Fortified to heavy hits until the preview tooltip and game-over leak diagnosis were reviewed.

sessions.build: lancer x3; cannon x1; slow x1
sessions.note: Correct composition and near-total spend could not cover both crossing packs.

sessions.build: lancer x9; cannon x1; poison x1; slow x1
sessions.note: Marginal Bulwark survived long enough to release the runner platoon; this was the accepted tuning case.
